rv.q: Perfect title, performance, direction, with Jeff Gardner’s sound effects creating the feeling of locations as Pam describes them...
Honed by Elina de Santos's direction, Sorsa delivers a nuanced take on a woman whose psychic punishment is delivered not only by society but also by herself.
Seeing Rachel Sorsa command the stage as few can makes the gut-wrenching seventy-five minutes you’ll spend with Pam quite memorable indeed.

cn.t: Rachel Sorsa delivers an extraordinary solo performance in this powerful but bleak drama about a mother's decades-long search for her vanished son. Critics recommend the show for its emotional depth.
